# Shipwright Studio

> Shipwright Studio is an independent engineering studio crafting websites, web apps, and AI infrastructure for startups and small teams. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, working worldwide. Founded and run by a senior software engineer.

## Services

- **Custom website development**: Fast, accessible, search-friendly marketing sites and landing pages. Modern stack, no bloated templates.
- **Web application development**: Interactive dashboards, internal tools, and customer-facing apps — designed, engineered, and deployed end to end.
- **AI infrastructure**: LLM application engineering, inference cost optimization, GPU communication and distributed training performance.

## Selected work

- **Lumen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lumen/): An interactive photography lab that teaches the exposure triangle (aperture, shutter speed, ISO) with real-time canvas simulations of depth of field, motion blur, noise, and light metering.
- **Forge** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/forge/): An LLM inference cost estimator. Enter model size, quantization, GPU type, batch size, and traffic to estimate GPU count, latency, and monthly serving cost.
- **The Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/ideas/): An open bank of 106 web experiments — games, developer tools, browser extension prototypes, and small apps. Two new experiments are designed, built, and shipped every day. Recent additions: **Mini Tower Defense** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/tower-defense/), a free online tower defense game — place arrow, cannon and frost towers along a serpentine path, survive 20 escalating waves, upgrade and sell towers, with wave previews and local best-wave tracking, all in the browser, **Barcode Gen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/barcode-generator/), a free online Code 128 barcode generator — type any text to render a crisp barcode with checksum, human-readable text toggle, size and colour controls, and PNG/SVG download, all computed locally, **Reading Mode** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/reading-mode/), a free online reading mode tool — strip any article to clean text, try it on three cluttered samples or paste your own HTML, with reading time, word count and typography controls, all in the browser, **Web3 Glossary Flashcards** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/web3-flashcards/), a free online flip-card study game — learn 40 essential crypto and web3 terms with plain-English definitions, Know / Still-learning piles, category filters and a review mode for missed terms, all in the browser, **Startup Idea Generator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/startup-generator/), a free online startup idea generator — roll audience, problem, technology, business model and twist into a named startup pitch, with per-slot locks, favourites, history and a self-referential meta mode, all in the browser, **Bitcoin Halving Countdown** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/block-countdown/), a free online Bitcoin halving countdown — blocks remaining to block 1,050,000, estimated halving date, epoch progress and reward schedule, estimates from a stated block-height anchor, all in the browser, **Chess Puzzles** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/chess-puzzles/), a free online chess tactics trainer — solve six verified mate-in-two puzzles with hints, solution lines and local streak tracking, all in the browser, **Lorem Studio** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/lorem-studio/), a free online placeholder text generator — classic Latin, startup buzzword or pirate themed text in 1–10 paragraphs, with copy, HTML export and .txt download, all in the browser, **Tab Search** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/tab-search/), a free online tab search prototype — search a realistic set of browser tabs by title or URL, with ranked results, window grouping, keyboard navigation and close-with-undo, sample data only, all in the browser, **Wallet Portfolio Pie** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/wallet-pie/), a free online wallet portfolio pie chart — enter holdings manually to see allocation as a donut chart with weights, totals and local persistence, values are manually entered demo data, not live prices, all computed locally, **Excuse Generator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/excuse-generator/), a free online excuse generator — pick a scenario, tone and believability level to get a ready-to-send excuse from a 48-excuse library, with a plausibility meter and one-click copy, all in the browser, **Bridge Fee Comparator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/bridge-fee-compare/), a free online cross-chain bridge cost comparison — pick source and destination chains and an amount to rank six bridges by fee and speed, with a cost breakdown, demo data only
